summary: Added an optional limit parameter to Table.search (defaulting to None), allowing search queries on default and custom tables to return at most the first N matching documents in document ID order. To ensure full query cache isolation, the complete unconstrained query match list is cached and sliced with [:limit] on return. Created tests covering all acceptance criteria and edge cases in tests/test_autose_issue_4.py.
